content_sections.heading: ANIIDCO Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ANIIDCO Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ANIIDCO Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Resident Engineer-cum-Co-ordinator: Graduate in Engineering/MBA or equivalent with minimum 2 years experience Surveyor-cum-GIS Expert: Graduate/Diploma in Civil Engineering with at least 5 years experience in surveying and GIS mapping. Proficient in AutoCAD, GIS Mapping, QGIS or ArcGIS Consultant (Project Monitoring & Follow up): Retired Government servant with graduation and at least 5 years experience in planning and monitoring of projects/schemes

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for all posts is 65 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Resident Engineer-cum-Co-ordinator: ₹40,000 Surveyor-cum-GIS Expert: ₹40,000 Consultant (Project Monitoring & Follow up): Last pay drawn minus pension

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANIIDCO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation (ANIIDCO).

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ANIIDCO recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Resident Engineer-cum-Co-ordinator, Surveyor-cum-GIS Expert, and Consultant (Project Monitoring & Follow up).

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for various posts in this ANIIDCO recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply or attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 17 August 2026, which is also the last date to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under this recruitment is 65 years as of the specified date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Resident Engineer-cum-Co-ordinator and Surveyor-cum-GIS Expert?
faq.answer: Both Resident Engineer-cum-Co-ordinator and Surveyor-cum-GIS Expert posts offer a salary of ₹40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article or on the official ANIIDCO website.
